try: Draw the kitchen’s walls with the usual heights on them
how:
1. "Tools" in the side navigation › "3D Space Planner"; open "Showroom — HDB 4-Room"
2. Open "Rooms", click "Kitchen"
3. In its panel open ⋮ ("More for this room") › "Wall elevations…"
4. Read the drawing, the line under it and the list
expect: "Kitchen · wall elevations" opens on the counter’s wall (chips Top · Right · Bottom · Left). Dashed lines cross the wall with short words beside them: "Sockets 30", "Counter 85", "Switches 120" and the cabinets’ band "Cabinets 145–225". Under it: "Dashed: the usual heights to work to — … Check them on site." The list names the pieces along the wall, left to right; "Download PNG" sits at the foot.

try: Hide the heights, then check a bathroom and an open side
how:
1. Switch "Show the usual heights" off, then on
2. Close the panel; do the same for "Bathroom" (⋮ › "Wall elevations…")
3. Close it; for "Living / Dining" pick the wall "Bottom (open)"
expect: Off, the drawing stands alone and gets wider; on, the lines come back. The bathroom’s wall shows "Mirror 150" alone — no sockets or switches. Living / Dining’s open side reads "Facing the open bottom side from inside the room · …" — no lines and no switch.
in10: Different from 1.0: switches and sockets drawn on every standing wall

try: See the showroom flat in 3D and keep a turning clip
how:
1. Close the panel; open ⋮ at the top ("Layout options") › "3D picture…"
2. Drag the picture to turn it; pick "Top-down", then "Dollhouse"
3. Press "Download a turning clip" and wait
expect: "3D picture" opens with "Look" Dollhouse · Top-down and a line for each ("An angled cutaway — …", "Straight down from above — …"). Under the Dollhouse: "One whole turn in 12 seconds, as a video to send on WhatsApp." The press counts down "Recording… n s" while the flat turns once, then "Turning clip downloaded" — a video lands in Downloads. The foot offers "Render in AI Visualizer" and "Download" (no "Save to Files": this layout belongs to no client).

try: Make a 3D picture from Farah Ahmad’s floor-plan photo
how:
1. Close it. Open Farah Ahmad › "Files" › the "Floor plans" folder
2. On "Floor plan — Waterway Sunrise.jpg" open ⋮ ("File actions") › "Make a 3D picture"
3. Read the window; press "Turn a quarter" four times
4. Switch "Straighten and clean it" off, then on
expect: "Make a 3D picture", "Step 1 of 2": "For Farah Ahmad — the photo is kept in their Files › Floor plans." After "Reading the plan…" and "Straightening the plan…" the plan sits square, with "Straightened by 7.0° and cleaned" under it. Each quarter turn redraws it; off reads "As it was taken", on puts it back.
in10: Different from 1.0: drawn from rooms you place, no credits

try: Square the plan by its four corners, then undo it
how:
1. Press "Square it by its corners" and read the line under the photo
2. Drag one corner a little, then press "Start the corners again"
3. Press "Square it"
4. Press "Undo" in the message
expect: The photo shows as taken with four round handles on the paper’s corners: "The corners start on the sheet it found. Put each on a corner of the paper: drag it, or Tab to it and use the arrow keys." "Next" waits while the corners are out. "Square it" reads "Squared by its corners and cleaned" with the message "Squared by its four corners"; Undo returns "Straightened by 7.0° and cleaned".

try: Check the rooms and the size, then start placing
how:
1. Press "Next"; read "The rooms" and "How big it is"
2. Press "Change the rooms"; take "Store" off the list (✕), press "Done"
3. Press "Place the rooms"
expect: "Step 2 of 2": chips such as "3 bedrooms" … "11 rooms in all", and "Started from HDB 4-Room — the flat type on record…". Store leaves the list (10 rooms in all). "How big it is" offers "Its floor area" · "A length on the plan", filled from the planner’s HDB 4-Room. "Place the rooms" opens the planner on the photo ("Traced — Waterway Sunrise"); a guide reads "Drag over the Living / Dining on the plan" and "0 placed · 10 to go · Esc stops".
in10: Different from 1.0: the room list comes from the flat type

try: Place two rooms, skip one, and keep the picture in Farah’s Files
how:
1. Drag a box over the living / dining area on the photo, then over the kitchen
2. Press "Not on this plan" for the next room
3. Press "Make the 3D picture"
4. Press "Save to Files", then "Open" in the message
expect: Each box becomes the room the guide named and the count moves on ("2 placed · …"); the skipped room leaves the list. "3D picture": "Traced — Waterway Sunrise — drawn from the layout…", with "… furnished by the planner’s rule for the picture …" and its Undo. "Saved to Farah Ahmad’s Files › Renders as “…”" — Open shows it in her Files.
in10: Different from 1.0: also kept in the client’s Files

try: Start a 3D picture from Benjamin’s floor plan
how:
1. Open Benjamin Han’s project › "Design" (it opens on "Choices"), then the chip "Floor plan"
2. Open ⋮ ("More options") › "Make a 3D picture"
3. Read step 1, press "Next", read "How big it is"
4. Press "Cancel"
expect: "Make a 3D picture" names the plan "…, from …’s Floor plan tab." and reads "As it is on the Floor plan tab" — no straightening, nothing to turn. Step 2 asks no size: "Its size is set on the Floor plan tab — about …". Cancel leaves the project as it was.

try: Open Floorplan to 3D Isometric from Tools
how:
1. "Tools" in the side navigation — find "Floorplan to 3D Isometric" (it wears "Beta")
2. Press it and read the page
expect: Its own page, "Floorplan to 3D Isometric" with BETA beside the title: "Turn any floor plan photo into a marketing-ready 3D view", the three steps, the box "Drop the floor plan here or browse", "What you’ll get" (Dollhouse · Top-down) and "Or try a sample plan" with the HDB 4-Room. Tools is lit in the side navigation.
in10: Same as 1.0: its own page in Tools, marked Beta

try: Take the HDB 4-Room sample to a dollhouse view
how:
1. Press "HDB 4-Room" under "Or try a sample plan"
2. Read "Your plan, straightened" and "We found"
3. Press "Generate dollhouse view"
expect: "Reading your floor plan…" with the steps Read the plan · Confirm the rooms · 3D render. The photo of the printed plan sits square: "Straightened by 7.0° and cleaned", with "Turn a quarter" and "Square it by its corners". "We found": 3 bedrooms … 11 rooms in all, "The sample’s own rooms, as its plan has them." "Opening the HDB 4-Room’s dollhouse view…" then the view — the flat's rooms where the plan has them — with "Sample · HDB 4-Room — its views were made ahead with the image model the live app uses."
in10: Same as 1.0, with a sample plan: the prototype has no image model

how:
1. Press "Regenerate", then again
2. Press "Download"
3. Press "Start a new plan"
expect: Regenerate shows the sample’s other take, then the first again. The file saves as "HDB 4-Room — Dollhouse.jpg" with the message "Dollhouse view downloaded". "Start a new plan" returns to the first page.
in10: Same as 1.0 (1.0 saved every view as 3d-floor-plan.png; its Switch style waits here for the sample’s top-down views)

try: Upload a floor plan of your own
how:
1. Press "Drop the floor plan here or browse" and pick sophia-floor-plan.pdf
2. Read "We found"
3. Press "HDB 4-Room" in its list
expect: The plan is read and straightened as with the sample, then: "This is the prototype, so your own plan isn’t read or drawn in 3D — in the live app, the image model lists its rooms and draws it in about half a minute. Try a sample plan to see the whole way through." No Generate button; the HDB 4-Room is listed instead and opens with its own rooms.
in10: Different from 1.0: on the prototype your own plan stops after it is straightened
